name: Pradhan Mantri POSHAN Shakti Nirman (Mid-Day Meal)
summary: A school nutrition programme that provides hot cooked meals to children studying in classes one to eight in government and government-aided schools, improving enrolment, attendance and nutrition.

eligibility_clauses.text: The child must be 6 years of age or older.
The child must be 14 years of age or younger.

entitlement_rules.text: Each eligible child receives a free hot cooked meal on every school day; there is no cash benefit.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the school level.
